answer: An identity registers only by locking 400 POA for 120 days against one hardware credential, 100% slashed on proven duplication. Splitting that credential across clones slashes every identity sharing it, so a farm cannot hide behind separate names. Each clone attempt leaves a ripple in the shared credential record, and auditors trace that ripple through shale-thin funding hops back to one source wallet. A relic of any prior slash stays attached to the credential and blocks re-registration. Verification takes seconds from the public vault. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked and unrecoverable.
